user.title: Connect to Philips TV
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Philips Google TV. Make sure the TV is powered on and connected to the same network.

pair.title: Enter PIN from TV
pair.description: A PIN code should now be displayed on your Philips TV screen ({tv_ip}). Enter it below to complete pairing.

lights.title: Select Target Lights
lights.description: Choose which light entities will follow the Ambilight colors.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to TV. Check the IP address and ensure the TV is on.
error.pair_request_failed: Failed to start pairing. Try again.
error.invalid_pin: Invalid PIN. Please check the PIN shown on your TV screen.
error.no_lights_selected: Please select at least one light entity.
